sanskrit: ṣaṭ śatena tathā proktā prāṇasaṃkhyā yathākramampadaistu yāvatī prāṇāḥ ekaikasya vibhāgaśaḥekaikasya tu varṇasya yā saṃkhyā vahatīśvareetadbhedavidhānajño bhinna dehassa ucyateyena yena hi mantreṇa karaṇaṃ kurute naraḥsa evaṃ mantramātmānaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥtanmadhyena tu mantrajño mocayenmucyateti catena tena kalenaiva mocayettatvavidguruḥtena yaṣṭe hute caiva sidhyate mucyate'pi catena yaṣṭe hute caiva sidhyate mucyate'pi cajñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa dīkṣāyogajapaṃ kuruhrasvadīrghāstu ye varṇāḥ svarayuktāstu ye smṛtāḥpraṇavoddhārabhedena jñātvā'traiva padāni tuhomaṃ pūrvoditasteṣāṃ kartavyo deśikena tukalāpatreṣu saṃsthāpya mantrakarṇikayā nyasetkartavyā deśikendreṇa siddhikāmena bhāminīevaṃ pūjya yathā nyāyaṃ dīkṣāṃ kurvīta deśikaḥveditavyaṃ prayatnena sādhakairmokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥyajjñātvā mucyate'vaśyaṃ bhavasaṃsārabandhanātpūrvādārabhya vijñeyamekaikasya yathākramamkathayāmi na saṃdigdhaṃ aśeṣantu tavānagheprāṇāśśatadvayaṃ jñeyāḥ prāṇatiṣṭhatastathaiva calavamekattṛṭistṛṃśat jñātavyaṃ surasundariahorātreṇa deveśi jñātavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥvyomavyāpini varṇānāṃ prāṇā vai ṣaṣṭi kīrtitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛṭistu pañcabhūtānāṃ ekaikasya varānanekathitaṃ tava deveśi padavarṇeṣu śobhanesadyasya vāmadevasya aghorasya tathaiva casadyaḥ kalābhiraṣṭābhiḥ ekaike tu yathā bhavetsahasradvayasaṃyuktaṃ tathā saptaśatāni caaghore tāvatī jñeyā deśikena mahātmanāsahasrārdhasamāścaiva tathā ṣaṭtṛṃśatāni caprāṇa ekassamākhyāto lavamekaṃ tathaiva capuruṣasya pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥetaddevi samākhyātaṃ jñātavyaṃ tatvavedināsahasrāstu samākhyātāḥ catvāro varavarṇinīekaikasya tu brahmasya kalā vai yāvatī smṛtākalācāraṃ samākhyātaṃ saṃkṣepānna tu vistarātśivāṅgān saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priyesarvātmeti samākhyātaṃ hṛdayaṃ paramātmanaḥsuśivo'ṣṭākṣaraḥ proktaḥ tasya pāraṃ śṛṇu priyeśatāni sapta vijñeyāḥ jñātavyaṃ deśikena tujvālinyāḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥprāṇaṣaṣṭiśca vijñeyāḥ trayaḥ prāṇastathaiva catṛṭiviśvasamāyukto ekaikasya varānanepiṅgalasya pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇuetasmin devadeveśi prabhuścarati nityaśaḥastrendrasya pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥśatāni pañcasaṃkhyāni prāṇānāṃ surasundaritṛṭiścaturthabhāgañca prabhuścarati nityaśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etaddevi samākhyātaṃ śivapīṭhe tu ye sthitāḥabhinnāḥ śivasaṃyuktāḥ mantrā vidyoditapradāḥśivasyāsanamāsthānamantrāḥ sarvajñakīrtitāḥpadavarṇavibhedena kalābhedena ye sthitāḥekaikantu padā mantraṃ japate sādhako yadimātṛkāyāḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvaśāstrasusaṃyutamtasmātsarvaprayatnena mātṛkācāramabhyasetakārādikṣakārāntā mātṛkā parikīrtitāḥekaikasya tu varṇasya śatāni catureva tutṛṭirekā tu vijñeyā sādhakena mahātmanāabhinnaṃ yajate yastu tasya cāro na vidyatedaśātmadehaṃ vakṣyāmi tadekāgramanā śṛṇuprāṇāṣṣaṣṭistathaiveha ekaikasya varānaneabhinneṣu varārohe bhavennityoditaḥ prabhuḥsahasratritayaṃ jñeyamekaikasya varānanedvayamekañca deveśi tṛṭirekā prakīrtitāhṛdayastu samākhyātaḥ śirasaḥ kathayāmi tesaṃkhyā vai tāvatī proktā śirasastu na saṃśayaḥnetrasyaiva pravakṣyāmi cāraṃ śṛṇu sulocaneetaccāraṃ samākhyātaṃ ekaikasya varānanevarṇasthaṃ kathitaṃ devi bhinnacārakathā bhavetsonādikastu bhagavān anākhyeyaṃ hyanāmayampīṭhaṃ ta sa tu deveśi kathitañcānupūrvaśasamudāyena mantrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhanesaṃvatsaratanurdevo yadi syādbhajane guruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍvarṇaṃ yajate mantrī tasyaiva japamārabhetbhinnāvasthaṃ tridhā kṛtvā na bhūyo janmabhāk bhavetutpattipralayaṃ jñātvā sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥetadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasitadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvatpriyārthaṃ varānaneetat jñānapadaṃ divyaṃ sa devāsuramānuṣametatsūtakamityāhuḥ sarvaprāṇiṣu vartatedvāvetau tyajate yastu sa bhavettatvapāragaḥmṛtakaṃ yo na jānāti sūtakañca svadehataḥbhoktavyaṃ sarvato devi tyakte mṛtakasūtakesūtakaṃ dehamadhyasthaṃ mṛtakañca tathaiva cautpattipralayaścaiva bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatimbhagavan śrotumicchāmi prāṇināñca hitāhitamkati prāṇāsmṛtā deva abde tu kathayasva mekathaṃ dīrghāyuṣañcaiva kathaṃ strībālayorapiśṛṇu devi parapraśnaḥ tvayā devi udāhṛtaḥmayā pūrvaṃ samākhyātaṃ tvayā'pi viditaṃ tathāvarṣe varṣe yāvatī prāṇā māse pakṣe tathaiva cagaṇitaṃ gaṇitairdevi prameyaparimāṇataḥahorātreṇa jñātavyo kālajñena mahātmanāete prāṇā mayā proktā śatabhāgavibhājitāḥśatadvayañca vijñeyaṃ prāṇānāṃ varavarṇinītṛṭiraṣṭau tu vijñeyā aho jīvasya suvṛtena na prāṇā smṛtaḥ pakṣo māsastadviguṇena caanena ahamukhyena jñātavyaṃ tatvavedinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prahare prahare caiva varṣāhyatra trayodaśaanena kramayogena veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥna kenacidahaṃ pṛṣṭo na mayā kathitaṃ kvacitbhāskaravyodaye jātaṃ bālakaṃ kaścamī diśetpañca ṣaṭ saptamāṣṭau ca yāvadvādaśakordhvataḥyāvadvarṣā bhavedyūnāṃ tāvadāyurvinirdiśetprāṇasaṃkhyaistu deveśi ye śavāḥ parikīrtitāḥprameyaprāṇavarṣā ye mūrtibāle tamādiśetevaṃ krameṇa deveśi jñātavyaṃ tatvavedināevañcaturthamādeśaṃ kṛtvā devi samādiśetevaṃ dhyānaparo bhūtvā yogī vai susamāhitaḥyo vegini bilenaiva devatāramitaṃ śubhamdhānādhivahane caiva nārī tyevaṃ samādiśetprathame viṣuve lagne puruṣasmṛtajātakaḥyadācāravibhāge tu avidhajñāstu yogavitcatuṣṣaṣṭi smṛtā marma dehināṃ dehamuttamamyāni kāni tathā cānye jñātavyāni yathākramamautpādakoni yāni syuḥ kathayāmi samāsataḥsīdanti sarvāṇyaṅgāni dāhaḥ śoṣaḥ kṣayo bhavetnāḍīsañcāratatvajño lakṣabhedā kṛtaśramaḥmṛtyuñjayādibhiryogaiḥ punastāḥ samaye budhaḥyasmin yasmin bhavetsvedaḥ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi tebāhusandhistritīyā tu stanābhyāntu caturthakamkaṇṭhasyaivopariṣṭhāttu ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai parikīrtitamjānusandhirmahāmarma cāṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdaye tu mahāmarma devi te samudāhṛtaḥādhyātmikāni yāni syuḥ tāni vakṣyāmi te śṛṇutadā devi vijānīyāt sadyo mṛtyumupasthitaḥna paśyati raso jihve ṣaṇmāsamadhikaṃ punaḥyo naraṃ vahate caiva marmastāvattatasmṛtaḥteṣāṃ vai sannirodhena marmaṇāñcaiva sundariayātmādātmanaḥ paśyedyadi syāttatvavedinaḥtadā tu praśamaṃ yānti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāveditavyaṃ prayatnena na dadyādyasya kasyacitkathaṃ saṃhārakāle tu veditavyaṃ hi yogibhiḥetadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasiyena vijñātamātreṇa cārajño nāvasīdatijñātvā śreyāṃsi kurvīta tadā'sau nāvasīdatitadā prabhṛti kartavyā kālasyaiva pratikriyātatra jñātvā punassamyagyathā mṛtyuñjayo bhavetmṛtasañjīvanañcaiva kathayiṣye yathā bhavettathā yena prakāreṇa rodhitena tu lakṣaṇammaṇibandhena śūnyena śṛṇu tasyaiva lakṣaṇamtilako dahyate yasya saṃhṛtaṃ taṃ vinirdiśetmāsaikādaśabhiścaiva mṛtyumabhyeti suvṛtemuhurmuhuḥ prakaṃpaśca saṃhṛtaṃ taṃ vinikṣipetśaṅkhau tu hīyamānau tu śṛṇu vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇamniruddhaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt pratyakṣañcaiva dṛśyatekaṇṭhanāḍyupariṣṭāttu staṃbhite lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuśoṣitastu varārohe saptamāsānna jīvati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṇṭhaśoṣaṃ bhavettīvraṃ niśleṣmaṃ kā samāvahetevaṃ vai lakṣaṇaṃ yasya caturmāsān sa jīvatiraktavarṇaṃ bhavenmūtraṃ dahatī ca na saṃśayaḥmuṣkasūtrapradeśe tu yasyaivaṃ śūlamāvahetevaṃ lakṣaṇato budhvā dvau māsau sa tu jīvatigate dakṣiṇato devi jīvenmāsaṃ sa pakṣakammāsamekaṃ na jīveta iti śāstreṣu niścitamstaṃbhitaṃ taṃ vijānīyādardhamāsaṃ sa jīvatitato'sau mṛtyumabhyeti divasairdaśabhistathātasya mṛtyuṃ vijānīyāt pañcāhāttu na saṃśayaḥvisvaraścaiva jāyeta hīnāyuṣoji bhāminīcakṣuṣī naiva dṛśyeta pūrvadṛṣṭañca rūpakamgulphadeśe yadā spandaṃ niṣpandaṃ bhavate yadihṛdayaṃ vepate yasya mūrchākaṃpaśca jāyatekaṇṭhe guḍuguḍoyetatkiñcitspandati suvṛtetālumadhye gato vāyuḥ kiñcitspandati suvṛteevaṃ marmavibhāgajñaḥ sādhako nāvasīdatiekādaśa śatañcāṣṭau nava sapta tathaiva camāsaṃ sa pakṣakañcaiva māsaṃ māsārdhameva caaharekaṃ vijānīyāddinārdhaṃ praharaṃ tathāmaṇibandhāditaḥ kṛtvā veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥkṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ pavitrāṇi japahomakriyāstathāetairmāyā mayā proktāḥ yathāsaṃkhyena suvṛtesamena savyamarmāṇāṃ yadi niṣpandatā bhavetśleṣmaṇā caiva deveśi niṣpandaṃ yānti te punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyadguhyatamaṃ devi śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi teiḍā suṣamnayoścāraṃ jñātavyaṃ yogibhissadāātmanaśca vijānāti yathākālaṃ vibhāgaśaḥutpātaṃ kiñcidākhyāti na tatra bhayamādiśetgotrasyācāśubhaṃ vidyānna mṛtyuṃ tasya cādiśetmahadbhayaṃ bhaveddevi grāmagotrasya suvṛteātmanastvaśubhaṃ vidyānmahākleśena jīvatiātmano mṛtyurāyāti iti śāstrasya niścayaḥrājñaścaivāśubhaṃ vidyādājyena ca viyujyatevāhanānāṃ kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kathayecchivayogavitrājñāṃ caiva bhayaṃ vidyānmahākleśena jīvatirājānamaśubhaṃ vidyānmahākleśena jīvatirājñāṃ maraṇamāśusyādyadi vai vinivartatejanānāmaśubhaṃ vidyādyāvatpañca daśe'hanievaṃ jñātvā tu medhāvīṃ na sīdennaiva yogavitetaddevi samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamamcāreṇa jñāyate * * kārayoge na saṃśayaḥnissate kiṃ pramāṇa syāt praviśepi maheśvaramahatpuṇyamidaṃ devi na pṛṣṭaṃ kenacitpurāprāṇasyaiva nirodhena sthātavyaṃ deśikena tutāvattakṣaṇamātreṇa sa siddhenaiva sādhakaḥyadā prāṇanirodhastu bhavate sādhakasya tuūrdhvabhāge care yāvadadhaśśūnyaṃ vinirdiśetutkarṣaṇī kalā sūkṣmā su sūtre ca dvitīyakāūrdhvaṃ sañcaratastasya kale dakṣiṇataḥ sthite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhunā dehagaṃ devi kathayāmi yathā sthitātālumadhye samākhyātaṃ susvarākhyaṃ varānanetasyopari śikhā vyoma nādākhyassa sadāśivaḥsvadehe devi jñātavyā devatā bhavanāśanāevaṃ ṣaṭ trividhaṃ jñātvā pañca vyomā parā sthitātasya sthānaṃ na vaktavyaṃ sa sarvatra vyavasthitaḥpañcavyomapadātītaṃ yadā prāpyati tatpadamyadā gurumukhāddevi vijñātaṃ pārameśvaramcintāhīnaśca yo devi sa sarvatra vyavasthitaḥtena hīnā na sidhyanti na ca yānti paraṃ padamna ca tena vinā siddhiḥ pūjayādhvarakarmaṇipañca vyomātmake dehe śaktirūpeṇa bhāvyatetadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasiyoniḥ pṛthak pṛthak bījaṃ vyoma ityabhidhīyatesthitāste vyomavaddevi tena vyometi kīrtitāḥtena sā devi ākhyātā vyomavyāpī paraśśivaḥtādṛśaṃ varṇarūpeṇa devadevamupāsyatevarṇayogaṃ yadā khyātaṃ tatsthānālaya bhogabhuksaṃyogātmaikamantreṇa kathaṃ mokṣo vidhīyatepaśumākṛṣyamātmasthaḥ prayāti paramaṃ padamtenānityā mahādevaḥ kathaṃ nityatvatā bhavetna saṃyogādbahirmantro jihvoṣṭhapuṭavarjitaḥicchāśaktirmaheśasya mantrātmāvasthitasya cauttameṣvuttamaṃ bhuṅkte madhyame madhyamaṃ tathādeśikatve samāsthāya paśuṃ gṛhya varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhomukhe prayātasya kale dve vāmatasthiteyāvaddakṣiṇato yāti tāvadvāmena śobhanemadhye tu niścalaṃ śūnyamayanaṃ taṃ vinirdiśettadā nirvāṇatāṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāśūnyasthānāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā priyenivṛttimadhyabhāge tu pratiṣṭhā tiryaguttarenādastu pañcamo jñeyaḥ sa śivaḥ parikīrtitaḥpañcamastu śivaḥ proktaḥ susūkṣmaḥ kathitastavajīvastu nāda ityuktaḥ sparśaśaktimayasmṛtaḥdvividhena tu deveśi kartavyo'nugrahassadādeyañca gurubhaktāya śivabhaktāya dhīmatemārutaḥ pravahaṃ brūte mantriṇaṃ mokṣakastathāetadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasiyena vijñātamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥbindunādena jñātavyaṃ śīghragaṃ salilaṃ nadettena vijñātamātreṇa amṛtatvāya kalpateākāreṇa yadā bhinnaṃ devadevaṃ sadātanesītakaṃpena hrasvena mukhenaiva karoti yaḥḍha ukāravibhāgena śrutvā pāpairvimucyateākāreṇa tu vinyasya dhyānādutkramate dhruvamadhastādvāyunā dīptamīkāraṃ vahnidevatamśṛṇoti vividhān nādān māsādabhyantareṇa tutribhirmāsaissa paśyeta pratyakṣaṃ sarvataḥ sthitamabhyāsena tu deveśi niścalaḥ saṃprajāyateṣaṇmāsānabhyasedyastu uccāmarapuraṃ vrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃvatsareṇa muktātmā bhavetsvacchandamṛtyukaḥhrasvakāravibhinnasya śṛṇuṣva surasundariudare raktavarṇantu madhyāhne tejamālinamahanyahani cābhyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ yoginā priyeyogamutpadyate tasya acirādeva yoginaḥevamādīni cānyāni kuryādākarṣaṇāni cacittagṛhāṇi ramyāṇi vāhinīśca tathaiva caṣaṇmāsayogayuktasya ityetatsamudāhṛtamsthūlātsthūlataro bhūtvā sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraḥ punaḥhrasvakā vibhinnasya kathitaṃ tava śobhanesakṛtprabhāvaviśadaṃ candrārkagrahaṇaṃ sthitamśūnyamākāśabhūtantu jarāmṛtyuvināśanamkṣutpipāsā vinirmukto nirdvandvacchinna saṃśayaḥdevaiśca satataṃ yāti ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇa tupaśyate devi bhūteśaṃ gaṇeśaparivāritamdhyānanirmathanāddevi siddhirutpadyate tataḥdūrasthaśca samīpasthaḥ pīṭhasthaḥ pīṭhavarjitaḥkiṃ dūramantiko vā'pi dūrāddūratarantu kimatiguhyataraṃ praśnaṃ kenacinnāpi pṛṣṭavāndūrasthaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sarvayogihitāvahamdaśarūpā mayā khyātā sarve dṛśyanti śobhanekhaḍgena gacchatastasya draṣṭavyaṃ lakṣamuttamambījadvayasamāyogājjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥetadvāraṃ mayā khyātaṃ jñātavyaṃ tatvacintakaiḥtattvayā viditaṃ sarvaṃ mayāpi kathitaṃ tava
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tvayā devi tathā jñātaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi tepīṭhasthaṃ nayanaṃ proktaṃ bindutatvaṃ samāsataḥjñātavyaṃ yogibhirnityaṃ adhamaṃ yogisiddhidamsarvakarmāṇi kartavyāṇyāśu siddhimavepsatāśakticeṣṭāvikārāṇi kurute nityameva cadṛśyā śaktiriti khyātā tvayāpi vihitā tathāyathā bindurmayā khyātaḥ śaktistu viditā tathāuccāraṃ dūramityuktaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhaneetattasmin mayā khyātaṃ parasyaivāparasya caetaddevi rahasyantu mayā khyātaṃ samāsataḥetatpraśnaparaṃ devi sarveṣāmapi cottamamśakticeṣṭāvikāre tu yattvayoktaṃ maheśvaraetatpraśnaṃ paraṃ devi sarveṣāmapi cottamamādhāro nāda ityuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ parikīrtitaḥsa nādo bindumāśritya śaktinā prerito yadābindorvarṇāḥ samudbhūtāḥ yataḥ śāstrañca vāṅmayamsuṣupta iva cātmānaṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ na bādhatesarvajñānatā śuddhā śivakāyādvinirgatābindunādasya yā ceṣṭā tatvānāñcaiva suvṛteśakteḥ samaraso devi kathitañcānupūrvaśaḥtatsarvaṃ śaktinā vyāptaṃ veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥtribhireva tu saṃyuktaḥ sa jīva iti kīrtitaḥīṣatsparśasamāyukta mukhanāsāpuṭasya tuiti te kathitaṃ devi śaktessamarasaṃ tathāpraṇavattrayantu deveśa yogādhyāye yaduktavān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dehasthaṃ yajātānteṣāṃ vyomasthañca tathaiva hiadhastātpañcatatvāni brahmoṅkāreṇa pūjayetśivatatve sthitā ye tu nidhanena prapūjayetśivapūjāvidhau paścādyogaṃ seveta yogavitteṣāṃ sthalaṃ pavitrādyaṃ praṇavena tu dāpayetyasmin pūrvāṇi deveśa kasmin sparśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥjīvasya bhūtasaṃsthasya tristhāne śṛṇu darśanammucyate nātra sandehaḥ siddhiścaiva na saṃśayaḥaṅguṣṭhaparvamātrantu pañcavaktraṃ maheśvarametadrūpaṃ mayā khyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu suvṛtedivārātravibhāgena ayane viṣuve tathāuccāraṃ sparśamityete kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥidaṃ tenābhijānante vivadanti parasparamtasmin sthitaḥ śivassākṣāt kathitaṃ tava suvṛtenā śiṣyāya pradātavyaṃ rahasyamidamuttamamtadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasivyomapadmamiti proktaṃ vyomaproktaḥ sadāśivaḥvyomanālasmṛtākāśaṃ diśā patrāḥ prakīrtitāḥdiśā patreṣu deveśi vidyeśān parikalpayetśikhādūrdhvamukhāstasya vyāpakanti vyavasthitāḥsvacchaṃ sunirmalaṃ tejaḥ suṣirajyotiruttamaḥetacca binduyogantu kathitaṃ tava śobhaneatra padme tu vijñeyaṃ yogibhistatra cintakaiḥpratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate devi tatvā ye pūrvacoditāḥtāṃ dṛṣṭvā yogavicchrīmān sarvajñatvaṃ prapadyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhaneidaṃ te kathitaṃ devi tārakaṃ jñānamuttamametadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasimānasaṃ manasālokya yaddalaṃ pratipādayetdhyāyellakṣavaraṃ divyaṃ pūrvadṛṣṭaṃ varānaneetaddevi samākhyātaṃ dhyānamānasameva tutadā yogamiti proktaṃ yuktasya varavarṇinīkasmin sandhyā kathaṃ saṃjño bhagavan kathayasva metvadīyaṃ padmakaṃ devi na dṛṣṭaṃ kenacitpurāanyeva paśusandhānaṃ kathayanti varānaneīdṛśaṃ tatvasandhānaṃ na vijñātantu deśikāḥtadā karmasamarthantu bhavate sādhakeśvaraḥtadā tatve tu saṃyojya vidhiṃ kuryādaśeṣataḥuddhṛtyacātmasaṃsthantu kṛtvā tatvavidaṃ śubhamvilīnāmāpamadhye tu āpa bhūtāṃ vicintayetevaṃ vai sarvatatvāni karma kṛtvā'nu saṃśayetevaṃ saṃsthitastatra paśunālokyettadātatvanīlaṃ nayettatvaṃ tatve tatve niyojayetsarvatantreṣu sāmānyaṃ vidhimetatsamārabhetkiṃ tatvaṃ prathamaṃ deva dvitīyañca tathaiva catatvantu prathamācāryaḥ tava devi udāhṛtaḥpaśutatveṣu saṃyojya pṛthivyādiṣvanukramātvidyātatvāspadaṃ kṛtvā yojayetparame padebhūtātmā tatra bāhyātmā antarātmā tu indriyaḥbhūtātmā indriyātmā ca paramātmā tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtātmā saṃsthito bhūtaiḥ indriyātmā tathendriyaiḥtrirātmānaṃ vinirmuktaṃ caturthaṃ parameśvaritasya sādātmakaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā caiva vibhāgataḥetatsamāsato devi rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tava
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhamo yogibhogādiṃ bhuñjate parameśvaraḥmadhyame tātvikaṃ bhogaṃ bhuktantu parameśvaraḥtṛtīyaṃ uttaraṃ bhogamiti vāritasarvabhukkrīḍate mantrarūpī so vṛścike pannageṣu catena tena hi bhāvena krīḍante parameśvaraḥsaṃśayo me mahādeva prasādī bhava śūladhṛkmātṛkāsaṃbhavāssarve nāsti mantramataḥ paramvedanīyāstu te sarve śivatatvānuvartibhiḥparato yanmayā proktassarveṣāṃ vyāpakasmṛtaḥekākṣarasmṛto mantro dvyakṣarāstryakṣarāḥ parāḥbahvakṣarā ye deveśi mantrāste saṃprakīrtitāḥsaṃyogena vihīnāstu na te mantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥtadevādau namaścānte saṃyogaṃ samudāhṛtamsaṃyogena vihīnāstu mantraśabdabahiṣkṛtāḥvyāpakena samāyuktaṃ saṃpatantaṃ vinirdiśetsvaramantraṃ vijānīyādvisargeṇa visargajāḥpañcadhā saṃsthitān jñātvā tataḥ karma samārabhetprerakassarvamantreṣu svaśaktibalavardhanaḥśrotumicchāmi deveśa paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi metatvaṃ padaṃ parañcaiva vidustatve yathā sthitamśṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchitamanakṣaramanuccāryamavyayaṃ vṛttalakṣaṇambindubhūtasthito yasmāt śivasya paramātmanaḥvidyātatvopari śrīmān saṃkrāntirdvādaśairyutamkālasaṃkhyārthaṃ deveśi dīpyate bhuvicāṃbare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sa dehastantu boddhavya svagataṃ dṛḍhagocaramsarvabhūtaṃ hṛdistho'sau jvalatpāvakavarcasamhṛsvastu dahate dhyānadīrghastu mokṣado bhavetviśatāt bindurūpācca viśeṣānalavigrahaḥvidante yena tattvāṃśca dehamadhye vyavasthitānlayaṃ gamayate yasmāt tasmādbinduriti smṛtaḥsṛjan saṃharate viśvaṃ sadāśiva niyogataḥkṣobhakassarvabhūtānāṃ tārakā iva candramāḥtārakācalitākāraṃ bindudevasya rūpakamsomeva saumyatā yadvat karṇikāyāṃ samāsataḥnetramadhye bhavedātmā chāyājīvasya dṛśyatekṣetrajñaḥ sa ca vai viṣṇuḥ puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥcatuṣkasṛṅkalātītaṃ binduṃ jñātvā śivaṃ vrajetākāro brahmaṇo rūpaṃ sātvikaṃ paricakṣateūkāraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpaṃ rājasaṃ tatpracakṣatemakāraṃ rudrarūpantu tāmasaṃ parikīrtitamsa binduriti vijñeyo yatrātmā dṛśyate sthitaḥdṛṣṭvā'ntaṃ sarvabhūtātmā sa śāntapadadīpakamatha * * * * * * devā vinyasya suvṛteākāraḥ śuklavarṇastu brahmā satvaguṇe sthitaḥkṛṣṇantu rudraviṣayaṃ tāmasaṃ tatpracakṣatesa binduriti mantavyo yatrātmā dṛśyate sthitaḥsa niṣkalo parādhyātmaṃ paraṃ brahmamidaṃ smṛtambindudevasya tatsthānaṃ parātparataraṃ mahatyasmiṃśca līyate bhūyaḥ tadbinduriti saṃjñitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrājalājyasaṃyogāt tadbinduriti saṃjñitampratiṣṭhā sṛṣṭirabhavat śāntisthaḥ sakaleraṇaḥdhvanimadhyagatastāraḥ tāramadhyagataśśivaḥnityāste nirvikāriṇyo nivṛttistena cocyatetiṣṭhatyalakṣitaguṇā pratiṣṭhā tūcyate tataḥyasmādvedayate tasmādvidyeti vihitā kalāna lipyate susūkṣmatvāt tasmācchāntirihocyatesadāśivākhyamityasmin nāmāni parigīyateyattacchivākhyamākhyātaṃ tattvamapratimaujasamdṛśyate naśyate caiva sthūlaṃ binduriti smṛtamharikuṅkumasaṅkāśo madhyamo bindurucyateśuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśo binduḥ jñeyaḥ parāparaḥdaśarūpañca boddhavya sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ parampītaṃ raktañca pītañca kapilo dhūmrameva casarvagrahavināśāya nīlaṃ vai parikīrtitamśvetādīnāntu sarveṣāṃ devatāḥ saṃpracakṣatekālāgnirudro navamo daśamastu sadāśivaḥboddhavyaṃ sādhakaiḥ prājñaiḥ munibhiḥ mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥatastṛtīyamevāhuḥ tatvārthaṃ gahanaṃ padamsaptamaṃ śūnyataraṃ syāt śūnyābhāsantathāṣṭamamsukāntaikādaśaḥ prokto dvādaśassuśivaḥ smṛtaḥdaśapañca varābhāsa dhruvo binduśca ṣoḍaśaavyayastu śivo yastu evamaṣṭādaśa kramātniśreṇyāttvekamūlena ārohetparamaṃ padamśūnyācchūnyataraṃ śūnyamuktamaṣṭādaśa kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: netrāśritā tu yācchāyā bhruvormadhye vinirgatāśṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchritameka eva yadā devi bindurityabhiśabditamvarṇahīnaṃ na kiñcitsyāt kūṭasthastena cocyateprakṛtyā jālagahanaṃ sarvamutpādya gacchatitasmādanyaistu saṃyuktamuccaretsarvakarmasubinduyuktena kartavyaṃ sarvakarmaprasiddhayepṛthivyādi vibhāgena jñātavyantu varānaneśataṃ śatañca hotavyaṃ tatvaṃ tatvena sandhayetekabījena hotavyaṃ sarvādhvānamaśeṣataḥsaplutoccārayodvarṇaṃ binduyuktañca kārayettasyānte tu punardevī pūrṇāhutyastu pātayetnetrāśritā tu yācchāyā tasyā lakṣaṃ vadāmyahamanyaśāstre tu yatproktaṃ tatsarvaṃ parikīrtitambindu bindviti deveśi vadante sarvayoginaḥkhaḍgasyābhimukhenaiva vimārgapravahena tumukhamāvṛtya tiṣṭheta lākṣāvarṇasamopamaḥnirdhūmāṅgārasadṛśaṃ piṇḍīkṛtamiva sthitamdvādaśārdhena māsena vyādhibhiśca na pīḍyatekurute nātra sandehaḥ śivatejopavṛṃhitaḥjāyate sarvakāmitvaṃ uddeśyaṃ tridaśairapitrailokye yatpravarteta pratyakṣaṃ tasya jāyatesṛjan saṃharate viśvaṃ śivavatsvecchatāṃ vrajettathā te kathayiṣyāmi adhunā śṛṇu cānyathājñātavyaṃ viditaṃ taiśca śaktilakṣaṃ suśobhane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣāśītamahālakṣaṃ drutalohathakālavitpratyakṣasya pravakṣyāmi yogasadbhāvamuttamamprasṛtā sarvamaṅgulya ekāṃ tatra samutsṛjettasminnagre tu saṃsthāpya abhyāsādapakarṣayetśanaiśśanaistu tallakṣamākarṣenmukhasaṃmukhamsuśītalamukhasparśaṃ anaupamyamanuttamammedhākāntisamāyukto māsamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥśaktivatsarvagāmitvaṃ bhavate sādhakeśvaresārvaśāstrasya vettā'sau vāgīśeva na saṃśayaḥdivyadṛṣṭyā tu yā siddhirasya saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇulakṣayīta mahālakṣaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakamagnivajjvalate yogī jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥagnivat jvalate sarvaṃ dusparśaṃ tridaśairapibrahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ naivalipyeta yogavitpratyakṣe śuklapītāni nīlakṛṣṇasitāni casutreṇaiva maṇiryadvadvedhitaḥ bhrājate śubheeṣa te tattvasadbhāvaṃ tava devi udāhṛtamtasya maṇḍalamadhye tu lalāṭasyopari sthitaḥdhūmravarṇantu deveśi anekakiraṇojvalammāsamātreṇa yogīndro yāṃ diśāmavalokayetsravantañcintayedbinduṃ turyacāreṇa yoginaḥetanmṛtyuñjayārthāya dhyātavyaṃ yogibhissadāvividhena varārohe sarvasiddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥdūraśravaṇavijñānaṃ mananañcāvalokanampūrvoktā yāni rūpāṇi sarvāṇyasmin pratiṣṭhitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhayaḥ santi sarvatra tattvālokeṣu suvṛtedurvidagdhe śaṭhe krūre anyāyapathavartineśivavartmanyate yastu ācāryaṃ tatvapāragamtasya deyamidaṃ jñānaṃ anyathā na kadācanakathayasva yathā nyāyaṃ kalādhvānaṃ mama prabhonivṛtyā ca yathā sṛṣṭiḥ pratiṣṭhāyā yathā bhavetśāntyatītañca deveśi kathayāmi samāsataḥprakṛtyante tu deveśi tasya sṛṣṭirudāhṛtāpratiṣṭhāyāstu hotavyaṃ dīkṣākāle maheśvarīvidyāyā homayenmantrī dīkṣākāle śivādhvareśāntyatītena deveśi dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ kramāthrasvahaṃso nivṛttiḥ syāt pratiṣṭhā dīrghabheditāvisargeṇa samāyuktā śānti vai parikīrtitāardhendunādasaṃyuktamūkāreṇa samanvitamtena pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāt śivasāyujyamicchatāmpratiṣṭhāyāntu saptaiva hotavyāni samāhitaiḥupariṣṭhācchivaṃ tatvaṃ śāntyāyāṃ samudāhṛtamevaṃ jñātvā tu mucyeta mocayecca na saṃśayaḥbindubhiḥ dyutinādena sa nādaḥ kena bhidyatemṛṇālatantusūtrābhaṃ nādaśūnyena bhidyatetasyāhaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathaṃ sakala niṣkalamkathayasva mehaśāna bhedaṃ tasya parāparamtadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi bindudevasya śobhanesthitaḥ saṃhāratatve'smin vyaktarūpaṃ svayaṃ bhuvaḥtadatītaṃ punardevi niṣkalaṃ kathitaṃ tava

sanskrit: etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ bhagavan vaktumarhasiijyate guṇamāhātmyāt sarvatatvādito mahānnapuṃsakaiḥ saha jñeya akṣarantu tripañcakamsa śivaḥ sakalo jñeyaḥ sa śivaḥ sṛjate kalāmbindu vijṛmbhate granthyā tataḥ śabdasamudbhavaḥśaktyaṃbunā'bhiṣiktastu bindutejoṅkuro mahāntadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvarinādamadhyāvasāno'sau notpattipralayātmakaḥna kṣīyate na cālpo'pi na nindyo vardhate kvacitvāyuvadbhramate nityaṃ mūrtibhirdaśabhistathāsa eṣa bhagavān bindussarvalokajagadguruḥsaptārṇavāvaśeṣoka dvādaśārkanipātanaḥihaikāṇḍaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ mṛtpiṇḍamiva saṃsthitamcibukārdhārdhakakṣeva maṇivattulayecchivaḥsa kālassa ca vai mṛtyussa indro varuṇaśśaśīsa brahmā sa ca vai viṣṇu rudra īśvara eva caprakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva niyatiḥ kāla eva cavedaṃ sāṃkhyañca yogañca bauddhamārhataṃ tathāsarvaṃ bindumayaṃ jñeyaṃ cittaṃ caitanyamākṛtiḥaprameyaśca sūkṣmaśca avyaktaśca sanātanaḥśivabhāvitadharmāṇāṃ bindudevassadātmakaḥlīnāṃśanātmayogena tadā sā niṣkalasmṛtaḥsthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena dviprakāraṃ prakīrtitamkathaṃ śarīre jñātavyaṃ tatvataḥ kathayasva metadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi nādajñānamanuttamam

sanskrit: kimanyā kāraṇe śaktiḥ ananyā vā prakīrtitāyadi nānyā bhavecchaktiḥ tayorbrūhi yadantaramananyānyatvabhāvena astināstīti saṃśayaḥtasmānnissaṃśayo brūhi agopyaṃ parameśvarasarvajñā cetanā śuddhā sarvatatvaprakāśikāguṇato doṣataścaiva śuddhāśuddheṣu prāṇiṣusarveṣvanugatā śaktiḥ nityaṃ sarveṣu tiṣṭhatia * * nātve ṣaṭ vartante'tha ceśvaraśaktayaḥākāśe cāvakāśitvaṃ tattvadīśvaraśaktayaḥsparśo'nileṃvare śabdastadvadīśvaraśaktayaḥśaktiśaktimatostadvadanāditvamiheṣyatetejo lokā svadehasthāstathā śakti pare śivedharmiṇaḥ svecchayā dharmaṃ pravṛttimadhitiṣṭhatidhṛte dharmiṇi dharmo'sau satkāraṇamihocyatekathayasva aśeṣantu tatvabhedaṃ parāparamkathañca śayane tatvā vidante svapnavāriṇaḥśvasane kasthitāstatvā dīrghaprāṇe care sthitāḥnṛtyato gāyataścaiva manyudaḥ karuṇotsukeeṣa karmasu saktānāṃ prāṇatyāgeṣu kā gatiḥvijñāyante kathaṃ tatvā aṣṭadhā navadhā sthitāḥantaḥkaraṇahīnāśca yathā dehe pratiṣṭhitāḥśṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ dehe tatvā yathā sthitāḥśrūyatāṃ jñānasadbhāvaṃ tatvabhedaṃ parāparamharṣonmādaśca saṃmohaḥ kathitaṃ surasundarīūrdhvedharonubhāvaśca vāmadakṣiṇatastathā

sanskrit: vāgvaktrādharanikṣiptamanimittanirīkṣaṇamevaṃ vai aṣṭadhā jñātvā etadvai śūnyalakṣaṇamhuṃkāramanasaṃyuktiḥ kalāḍhyaḥ kathito'ṣṭadhāmanyukāruṇyasaṃyuktaṃ mukhasaṃsthamupalakṣayetanalānilavikṣiptaṃ geyaṃ jhaṅkārasaṃyutamāghūrmitaṃ vighūrmitaṃ suṣuptaṃ suptalakṣayetkṣayāntasya guṇāhyete jñātavyāstatvacintakaiḥhuṃkāraṃ jarjharavākyañca kaṇṭhoṣṭhaye nigamāṣṭakamudāne sakalo devo vyākule niṣkalaṃ paramrahasye tu kalāsāraṃ vikrameva malaṃ smṛtamkṣayamantaṃ varārohe unmāde cāvadhārayaūrdhvaṃ sakalasaṃyogaṃ niṣkalaṃ dhārakaṃpitamvāme kaleśvaraṃ tatvaṃ dakṣiṇe bhujamālinamkṣayamantaṃ varārohe niṣkalo dehalakṣitaḥsakalaṃ vaktramārge tu vāmamārge tu niṣkalamanimitte kalāḍhyastu nirīkṣe khamalasmṛtaḥhṛdgatakṣayamantastha udbhāse kathayāmi tetrividhena tu vijñeyaṃ jñānabhede malāṣṭakamhṛdyātā sakalo devo niṣkalasyādalakṣitaḥkalāḍhyo bhāsite vidyāt khamale śvāsakaṃpitekṣapitantu varārohe huṃkṛtena tu lakṣayetcaturthaṃ bhedametattu kathitaṃ surasundarīgalānantapadaṃ vidyāt hāsye śūnyārtha lakṣitamkaṃpite kṣapaṇaṃ proktaṃ kathitantvanupūrvaśaḥpañcamaṃ bhedametaddhi kathitaṃ tvanupūrvaśaḥ

sanskrit: vyāpite śūnyamityāhuḥ eṣa te bhujamālinampṛthak bhāvassadā hyete boddhavyāstvaparājitejhaṅkārasvarasaṃyuktaṃ kaṇṭhoṣṭhyaṃ surasundarīaghūrmite kalādhāraṃ vighūrme niṣkalātmakamsvapne tu kalanātkālaṃ svapnānte khamalaṃ smṛtamkaṇṭhoṣṭhyantu vibodhe tu subhedaḥ saptamaḥ kramātśīghraṃ śūnyaṃ vijānīyāt svagatamupalakṣayethuṃkāre kṣapaṇo devaḥ sarvametadvipārayetvākye sthūlapade śubhre kaṇṭhoṣṭhyaḥ sarvatasthitaḥtatvaṃ vijñāyate samyak vidhipūrveṇa niṣkalamhaṃsākhye bindunādañca ardhacandre nirodhikāakṣare cākṣaraṃ sarvaṃ boddhavyamanupūrvaśaḥevaṃ vai hyaṣṭadhā bhedaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tava śobhanevākyasthaṃ hṛdayasthantu dadāne vaiva saṃsthitamśivañcānugataṃ vidyā vidyārājñāntu vikramaḥapākaprabhavaṃ divyaṃ nābhikarṇāntavarjitamkarṇanābhyantare tāluṃ padmanālānukuñcitamubhau tau tatkṣipattatvaṃ śāntattvaṃ sakalaissahaūrdhvavāhamanau gāraṃ prasphurantaṃ samāsataḥhṛtpadmenābhideśantu karṇatālukamadhyayoḥudāne niścalasthāne sarvasthāne sulocaneetacchabdāṣṭakaṃ devi hitāya samudāhṛtamanādinidhanābhāvadurlakṣaṃ śūnyabhāvanātenedaṃ jñātaṃ suśroṇiryasya bhāvena matsthitiḥabhāvasya parityāgī bhāvopagatacetasaḥ

sanskrit: śrutismṛtyartha vākyaiśca kāvyālaṅkāraśobhanaiḥabhāvaśśūnyatāṃ yāti śūnyañcābhāva ucyateabhāvena sadā śūnye mano niścalatāṃ gatamyoginaśca tathā cānye kupatheṣvapi ye sthitāḥte'pi cātra bruvantyaiva gatiratra kuto'nyataḥevaṃ me saṃśayo deva yatsatyaṃ tadbravīhi memātṛkā śivarūpeṇa buddhisaṃbhavapādapammama bījodbhavāssarve tava yonivinirgatāḥsaṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtañcaiva apabhraṃśānunāsikamtvaṃ sadā darpiṇī devī ahaṃkāraratā sadāavikāraṃ tato loko madvikāramapāsitambhuñjatāṃ ṣaḍrasāhāraṃ mriyante sarvajantavaḥmṛtpiṇḍeṣu ghaṭo yadvat tantuṣveva paṭo yathāmūlajñānaṃ japitvā tu yuktā dhyāyanti yoginaḥpravṛjya labhyate mokṣaścaryayātha maheśvarajñānena labhyate deva tat jñānasya prakāśakaḥtanmamācakṣva deveśa atra me saṃśayo mahānkṣapaṇāccaiva dehasya mokṣamicchantyabuddhayaḥkṣutpipāsī tathā varṣī mokṣārthī subudhassahetnetadvai jananaṃ vākyaṃ jagadvyāptiṃ na muktayemokṣo bhavati jñānena dehī nirmuktakevalamvinītarathamārūḍharacakṣuriva sārathiḥpañcarātrivido ye tu anyaiḥ pāpādukaissahaagniragnau yathā kṣiptaṃ toye toyamivārpitamnirvāṇassa tu vijñeyaḥ sukhaduḥkhavivarjitam

sanskrit: sarve kliṣṭāstathātyantaṃ mokṣatatvamajānataḥjīvanāśo bhavedyatra nissukhaṃ niṣpracetanamteṣāṃ māyodaro mokṣassa caitanyamavasthayāavamānena mokṣeṇa cetanārahitena tuasmin śaive mahājñāne vijñānanagare śubhe !patibhāvasamatvaṃ vai bhavate jñāninaḥ sa tuduḥkhānāmāgamo nāsti sukhaṃ tatra nirantaramcetanābhāvayormuktiḥ na tu saṃmohamocitāḥśivo nirañjano bhūtvā tiṣṭhate rāgavarjitaḥaśarīrī śarīrī vā svecchayā ca bhavatyasauaiśvaryaṃ sarvalokeṣu bhuñjate ca yathā sukhamśivajñānaṃ paraṃ prāpya nirguṇaṃ sarvakāmikamsarvaṃ vyāpya pratiṣṭhante sarvabhūteṣvavasthitāḥaprāpya sarvalokeṣu nā gatiśca kadācanaprakṛterye vikārāstu nirguṇaṃ guṇameva caye caiśvaryaguṇāssarve śive tiṣṭhanti śāśvateaprameyabalopetassarvajñaḥ khalu sarvadaḥdūrācchravaṇavijñānamananañcāvalokanamsvādhīnassarvakāryeṣu pravṛtte balisūdanaḥdamanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ manaśconmana eva caajaraścāmaraścaiva akṣayaḥ kṣobhakārakaḥajñānasaṃbhavāhyete sukhañcaikañca kevalamsa śāntasamaye prāpte na bhūyo viśate'raṇimsamyak jñānaṃ viditvā tu paśutvaṃ na bhavetpunaḥviditvā śāstrasadbhāvaṃ mṛtyuduḥkhaiśca pīḍyate

sanskrit: apratyakṣā gatirdeva brūhi me parameśvarasa śūlo vāyuvegena dakṣiṇastanakoparihrasvadīrghaplutañcaiva sādhāritasakauśakamaṣṭābhenaiva saṃyuktatantriṇī amṛtaṃ smṛtamlaukikāsteṣu vijñeyā śivatīrthyānu me śṛṇuabhijiccaiva nakṣatraṃ tasyopari jayantikādhruvatārāgaṇajyotsnā cakravatparilelihettadā mṛtyuvaśaṃ yāti pūrṇābde tu na saṃśayaḥdānaṃ japaṃ tato dhyānaṃ tatsarvaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavetyatkiñcitkurute karma tatsarvaṃ mokṣasiddhidamjñātvā vāraṃ tithiñcaiva tatsarvaṃ siddhimokṣadamamṛtena tu saṃyuktaṃ ābhyāṃtvekena mokṣadamevaṃ vai yo vijānāti rahasyamidamuttamammṛtaṃ kāyaṃ na śīryeta etatpratyayamuttamamyajanti viprā yajñaistu mūrtyaṣṭakasaṃyutāḥte'pi kasmānna mucyanti mantraistaireva dīkṣitāḥvarṇairevacitā vedāste'pi kasmānna muktidāḥśatārdhākṣaravinyāsaṃ puruṣaṃ binduvigrahamvṛkṣagulmalatānāntu oṣadhīnāṃ sa saṃbhavaḥyakārākṣaramityeke prāṇādyā viśvatomukhamrakāramanalañcātra prapadanti vipaścitaḥannapānendhano bhoktā sa jīvātmeti cocyatevibhūriti imaṃ prāhuḥ tacchakramavapūjitamamṛtasyandakundābhaṃ candrāṃśusamaśītalamathāhurapare kecidvyomabījamanuttamam

sanskrit: ubhayārthaprasidhyarthaṃ śaivaṃ jñānamudāhṛtamsarvaṅgateṣu bhagavān na hi deheṣu pūjyateāvāhanamanudhyānaṃ mano bhukti nirodhanamarcayet sakalaṃ devaṃ japetsakalaniṣkalamvyomni sphaṭikaśuddhābhaṃ jarāmṛtyuvināśanamsnāne tu nirmalo mantrī japātsiddhirna saṃśayaḥdhyānena sarvagaṃ devaṃ yogayogitvamāpnuyātāvāhanaṃ sthāpanañca sānnidhyaṃ sannirodhanamna caivāvāpyate kaścinna ca kaścinniveśyatevyāpī mantrasvarūpeṇa cintayanti paraṃ śivamsamādhistho'pi deveśa kathaṃ tiṣṭhati niścalaḥyogaḥ pañcavidhaḥ proktaḥ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇaḥteṣāṃ hi calate nityaṃ karmāsaktamanassadāeteṣāṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhatitadevaṃ kṛtakṛtyaḥ san nyaste sanyāsa ucyateatītya prakṛtauhyaṣṭau vartante puruṣeśvarādvaitabhāvārthasaṃsiddhā punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ vrajanti tenirodhādyogasaṃsiddhiḥ mokṣasteṣāṃ na vidyatenāsau sāyujyamāpnoti na bhavedyāvadekatāna teṣāṃ tu paraṃ sthānaṃ ātmendriyaniṣūdanātetatsaṃśayayogīnāṃ gatānāṃ punarāgamaḥvidyā yogātmikā devi vidyābhāvādhigacchataḥavaśyāveśyayogitvātte tu vyāpyamudāhṛtamna yogī yuñjakaḥ kaścinna ca cakṣurnimīlitamsāvalaṃbehyanityatvaṃ nirālaṃbepi śūnyatā

sanskrit: yathā śiśurakiñcijjño mūḍhopyuktā na śāyitaḥajñāyamāne tajjñānaṃ jñāte sat jñeyamiṣyateyathā tajjñeyayogena manasthāsyati niścalammanastu kathayiṣyāmi caturbhedasamāyutamsātvikaṃ rājasañcaiva tāmasañca viśeṣataḥcaturthantu mahadyogaṃ anaupamyamanāmayamyena vijñātamātreṇa unmanatvaṃ sa gacchatimanaścaturvidhaṃ proktaṃ bhedaṃ tasya imaṃ śṛṇusvalīno viṣayairmuktā ekībhūtassuṣuptavatna ca tairyujyate jñātassaṃ śiṣṭassa tu ucyatecalate yasya daurbalyāt tasyā'sau gatirāgatiḥtrikālamātalo nityaṃ sa tu vikṣipta ucyatemadhyamassa tu vijñeyo saṃśiṣṭassātvikaḥ smṛtaḥtāmasaḥ sa tu vikṣiptaḥ caturthohyadhamo mataḥnirguṇatve'dhikatvena yatra līno bhaviṣyatisuṣuptādadhikatvena ceti nātra viśeṣaṇamna cānyo jñāpakastatra yāvannasvatasvayamyogāvasthā parā hyeṣā prāhuryogavido janāḥtadāhyaśeṣavijñānaṃ vināśamupagacchaticalito'pi manastasya calitvā yāsyate kutaḥjñeyaṃ sarvasamatvañca dhyānānnirviṣayaṃ manaḥnirguṇo lakṣya rahitaḥ śivayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥyathā vāyuḥ suśīghro'pi muktvā'kāśaṃ na gacchatibhuṅkte tu viṣayān sarvān nāsau lehyalepakaḥkāyānubandhicalite nā'sau calati niścalaḥ

sanskrit: evaṃ yonijito dhīraissa gatvā kiṃ kariṣyatirāgakṣaye tadā puṃsāṃ manaśśīghraṃ nivartatesa ca tyāgī śarīrasya suruddho na bhaviṣyatitrayodaśa vidhastena karaṇaṃ niścalīkṛtamniścalaṃ na kadācit syāt ayutasya yutasya vāpuryaṣṭakaṃ ca tanmātraṃ budhyahaṃkārameva cacalate tu sadā devi sukhaduḥkhena mohitāḥyasya tulyasukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ manastasya suniścalamna yogī yuñjakaścaivārthatastu tvayā vibhokathaṃ yogaṃ mahādeva jñeyasya kathayasva mehṛccātināsikāgrasya vīkṣaṇānna nimīlanampratipūritavadvāyuḥ sūkṣmeṇa suṣireṇa tuvāyupūrṇaśarīrantu dṛtivallakṣyate prabhokṛtakasya tu adhvānaṃ jñātavyaṃ sarvathā vibhoetanme saṃśayaṃ deva yattsatyaṃ tadbravīhi meguṇavadgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā kathayetparameśvaramprakramādhvānamārgantu uccārakaraṇāni caevaṃ sa nirjito tiṣṭhet mano durjayacañcalamanirjito yathā mallo darpaṇīkurute bahūnna hi gantā bhavetkaścit gantavyañca na vidyateghaṭasaṃvṛtamākāśaṃ nīyamānamitastataḥkadalīsāravaddehaṃ vṛtaṃ tatvadalaissthitamnirākārātmavijñāne bhāvanāgatacetasaḥmokṣo nāma sa vikhyāto sa śarīro nirākṛtiḥna mokṣasya bhavettasmāt na cādhvānaṃ kadācana

sanskrit: pratimāsaprayogena ebhiḥ karmāṇi kārayetpratyakṣaṃ jāyate tasya sidhyante ca śivo bhavetpañcarūpadharaṃ hyetat pañcamaṃ yatprakīrtitamteṣāṃ madhye punaryogī paśyate ūrmisaṅkulāmsabhoga bhogisaṅkāśāmindrāyudhasamaprabhāmtathā tathā tu saṃpaśya ūrmirevatirantaramsatatābhyāsayogena sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥdivyadṛṣṭitanurdivyā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥdūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ manaścāvalokanamantardhāno tathā karṣo pādacāre tathaiva caāgneyaiḥ śoṣaṇaṃ kuryāt tāḍanaṃ māraṇāni caāpyāyanāditaḥ kṛtvā vāruṇena tu kārayetaṣṭāviṃśati mātrasya lakṣahyetāḥ prakīrtitāḥlakṣitavyā prayatnena yadicchetsiddhimātmanaḥātmā tu kāñcanacchāyā akṣṇī āvṛtya tiṣṭhatisitaraktapītakṛṣṇamindrāyudhasamaprabhamlakṣayīta punastāntu rājikāparivarttulāmsarvadevamayo devi devānāñca pṛthak pṛthaktayoryogī divārātrau nānyaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣāsugandhāsya tanurdivyā jāyate tṛptireva canaśyanti puṇyapāpāni tamaḥ sūryodaye yathāekonatriṃśake tatve tulyametadvarānanetasya lakṣamidaṃ devi śṛṇu ekamanā mamakaṇṭhatālvoṣṭharahitaṃ mantroccāravivarjitamaprayogamanāraṃbhamanāyāsopalakṣitam

sanskrit: kṛśayantīṃ sadā devi cintayenmantradevatāmpāṣāṇadhāriṇīñcaiva kāṣṭhahastāṃstathaiva camāraṇoccāraṇādīni kurute nātra saṃśayaḥsaumyāṃ śuklīṃ mahādevi śvetapadme vyavasthitāmcandrāṃśudhavalassaumyāḥ prāsādaṃ savyapāṇināvaśīkaraṇa ākarṣe pāśamaṅkuśadhāriṇīmstaṃbhane kṛṣṇavarṇāntu nityameva vicintayeteṣa devi samākhyāto nyāsaḥ paramadurlabhaḥevaṃ nyāsa iha proktaḥ sarvamantreṣu cottamaḥabhojya bhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā hatvā lokaṃ carācaramsuvarṇasteyagodānaṃ hutvā bahutarāṇi caevaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā ācāryassusamāhitaḥkālayāgavidhānena deśiko yajate yadiekāhamapi mayā nyāsaṃ kurute sādhakottamaḥsaptāhamabhyasedyastu imaṃ nyāsaṃ samāhitaḥmāsādutpadyate yogaḥ trisandhyaṃ yastu cintayetsarvaṃ saṃpādayatyeṣa lokasyaiva hitāhitamtrailokyasya tu vṛttāntaṃ kathayennātra saṃśayaḥgacchate nātra sandehaḥ sādhakassusamāhitaḥsiddhyate nātra sandehaḥ yoginastu na saṃśayaḥākāśagamanañcaiva daṇḍakāṣṭhapavitrakamjñātvā nyāsamidaṃ devi vinyāsamanyatpalālavatātmāhyatraiva jñātavyo devāścaiva viśeṣataḥsādhakasya ca dātavyamācāryasya tathaiva capañcabrahmeśavāṅgānāṃ rūpāṇi kathayasva me

sanskrit: pañcabrahma śivāṅgānāṃ sāmānyaṃ parameśvarinavasūtre purā proktaḥ rūpāstā eva śobhanehṛdayasya pravakṣyāmi rūpaṃ śṛṇu sulocanedyotayantaṃ hyadhaścordhvaṃ hṛtpradeśe vyavasthitamśiranyāsaṃ śiro devi hārakundendusannibhamindukoṭipratīkāśaṃ śikhāṃ deviṃ vicintayettena nyāsena dhyānena sādhakassusamāhitaḥkavacaṃ sarvagātreṣu sūryakoṭisamaprabhamnyāsena sidhyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇātrāsayantaṃ mahādevi vighnāścaiva vicintayetpaścāttu sādhanaṃ kuryāt nivighnaiḥ siddhimāpnuyātastramadhye japaṃ kuryāt tadā sidhyati nānyathātatra pāśupataṃ hastraṃ śivāṅgaṃ ghorasaṃjñitamtadā nirvighnato devi sidhyate sādhakottamaḥtadā nirvighnamāyāti sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥkṛtvā pañcaravatyogaṃ madhye tu japamārabhetpramāṇaṃ japitaṃ mantraṃ punareva tu suvṛtetadā siddhimavāpnoti devyā mānuṣakṛtrimāḥsarvakarmakaraḥ śrīmān karmaṇā manasā girāyogasiddhimavāpnoti mantrāssiddhyanti nānyathānaṣṭañca kathayeddevi śāstrāṇi vividhāni caguruṃ jñātvā mahādevi kalpate nātra saṃśayaḥyasmin sthāne tu te śodhyāḥ ekadikkāmavedituḥtathā te kathayiṣyāmi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇupañca pañca suvaiyojyā deśikena mahātmanā

sanskrit: evamatvaṃ tathā tejo āśuge vai tathaiva cakarmendriyacarusthañca śrotrajñānendriyaṃ smṛtamśāktau śivaṃ tathaiveha ekaikaṃ kramaśastathāahaṅkārastathā ṣaṣṭho anulomādviśodhayetkalānāṃ nirṇayañcaiva tatvānāṃ nirṇayastathājñātvā bhaktimayaṃ śiṣyaṃ dīkṣāṃ vyākhyātumarhasiniṣkalaṃ śrotumicchāmi sakalaṃ vyāpya viṣṭhitamyena muktassadharmātmā dharmotsanno nigadyateameyassarvagaśśuddhaḥ sarvaśaktikalānvitaḥekāntāvasthito hyeṣaḥ śivaśaktisamanvitaḥjagatkṛtsnaṃ mahāyogaṃ śaktiyogaṃ marīcibhiḥśāntatvāt svakartṛtvāt śaktimatvānmahaujasaḥprakurvanti jagatkṛtsnaṃ śaktayastā mahātmanaḥsarvākāramanākāramanaupamyamanāmayammantratejomayonityamacintyaḥ paramaśśivaḥvāgviśuddhaḥ parajyotiḥ svatejo dṛḍhagocaraḥsusūkṣmamavyayannityaṃ kāraṇaṃ jyotiruttamamvidyutparārdhakoṭīnāṃ tattejo vyāpya tiṣṭhatitejasā tasya dīpyante mahātejāśca sa smṛtaḥevaṃ vrataḥ paro devaḥ sa tejastejasāmapinirmalādarśakaprakhyaṃ śaradvārisamaprabhamatyantanaṣṭatamasā ūrdhvabhāsā diśo daśanityaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvamsarvabhūtātma bhūtastha paraṃ vyomaśivo'vyayaḥniścitya kartṛkartā ca sarvabhūtapatiśśivaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00251 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarve śuddhāśca nityāśca ye sthitāśśivagocarepṛthagrūpantu yatproktaṃ sādhakaiḥ śāstracintakaiḥmahādyutirmahābhūtiḥ mahātejā mahāyaśāḥagrāhyaṃ sarvabhūtasthamakṣobhyañcāvyayaṃ tathāātmasaṃsthañca vijñeyamarūpañcāpratiṣṭhitamajañcānantarūpañca agotrapitṛmātṛkamanādimadhyanidhanamacālyamacalaṃ dhruvamsamañca sarvabhūteṣu satataṃ vitatantanumnirmalaṃ nirahaṅkāraṃ nirbuddhiñca nirindriyamnityodayaṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirāmayamna nimnaṃ nodhritañcaiva na vakranna ca vā ṛjuḥna trikoṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ na caiva parimaṇḍalamna parokṣaṃ samakṣañca na gatirna ca vā gatiḥna cāsti na ca vā nāsti sarvasthaṃ kimavīṣṭhitamna paraṃ pratyayaṃ vedyannāparaṃ kiñciducyatena tatra jāyate sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhāro naiva jāyateavyayañca dhruvannityamanaupamyamanāmayamsadā śāntaṃ sunirvāṇaṃ paritṛptañca sarvataḥabhojyañcāpyabhuktañca svacchañcaiva sunirmalamdharmādharmaguṇaihīnaṃ saṃśritaṃ na ca kenacitvirajaṃ cārajaṃ śuddhaṃ śivadharma paviśca yatdūṣaṇādoṣarahitaṃ na calaṃ nāvacālitamanantanahanaṃ sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇātītalakṣaṇamsarvakāraṇadharmañca kāraṇātītalakṣaṇamna ca tacchakyate jñātuṃ vinā tasyāpyanugrahāt

sanskrit: guruvaktrāttu labhyeta tacchaktyā saṃpracoditātyaḥ prapadyedidaṃ sarvaṃ jñātaṃ tenāpi sarvataḥtadīryatenātra bhedena manasā tu manonmanauaśuddhaṃ śuddhatatvantu vyomāmṛtapadodbhavaḥsvaprakāśaparaṃ vedyaṃ na kenāpi prakāśatetathā'sau paramo devaḥ svaśaktraivāvalokatesarvadoṣavinirmuktamasāmānyaguṇodayaḥkopaprasādarahitaḥ prabhuranya īśaḥmahāmālañjanājālavyatītatanurīśvaraḥna vidyante yatastasya śāntaṃ śivapadaṃ tataḥśivatvaṃ gīyate śaṃbhoḥ sadā saumyaṃ mahātmanaḥsarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ nityaṃ śubhakaraṃ śivamjagadgurussavijñeyaḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaḥnissahatvajaṭādhāraḥ śivacandrakirīṭavānnirāvaraṇamannatvaṃ trailokyaṃ divyacakṣuṣaḥacalaśśāśvato vyāpī ajonityasvayaṃbhuvaḥsarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥanakṣaramanutpādyamanirdeśyamanāmayamsākṣivatsaṃsthito nityaṃ triprakārasya karmaṇaḥyasya yasya manaśceṣṭā śubhe vā yadi vā'śubhekṣaṇaṃ yatpaśyate sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ hitāhitamsarvamātmani paśyeta na ca saṃyujyate vibhuḥśṛṇute manute nityaṃ na tu yujyati sarvataḥśrotā vaktā ca bhoktā ca mantā ca sukhaduḥkhayoḥaśeṣabhuvanavyāpī niśśeṣo bandhamokṣakṛt
